decisions.reason: This drain housing builds directly on the firm's established drainage engineering, compatible product families, and application know-how, so absorptive capacity for improving and supporting it is high.
A floor-level shower drainage system is central to the firm's core market and future direction, making it highly related to existing knowledge and therefore very likely to be retained.
As a designer shower drainage flagship, it closely matches the firm's stated strategic focus and can be refined using strong in-house knowledge of design-conscious drainage solutions.
The shower element with integrated slope complements the firm's installation and waterproofing expertise, so early market learning can be absorbed and applied effectively.

Although somewhat less tied to the premium bathroom design focus, the backflow-protected basement floor drain still fits the firm's drainage competence and problem-solving reputation in technically demanding installations.

The air-admittance valve is more peripheral to the firm's main shower and floor-drainage specialism, but it remains close enough to building drainage systems that the firm would more likely continue and adapt it than withdraw it quickly.
